after.why: DEPTH: record this vertex's Z against its scratchpad slot. The recompiler's pz tap missed this arm — see native_world.cpp. a0 is (SXY2 << 5) | clipcode, derived from the same mfc2 whose SZ3 slot 2 already holds (gte_hold_pz at 0x800262E8), and sp is this vertex's 8-byte cache slot, so this is the same record the fall-through arm gets at 0x800262F8.
